item.description: The iPhone Duo will start at $2,770, putting it among the most expensive mainstream smartphones on the market and marking the first major test for Apple's new CEO. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: WA's $30 million 'State of Energy' ad campaign under fire from opposition
item.description: An advertising campaign by Western Australia's government to promote the state's efforts to transition to renewable energy is blasted by the opposition as a waste of money. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Keane Bourke

item.title: Live: ASX falls as oil price hits $US101 a barrel
item.description: The Australian share market falls to a seven-week low as Wall Street closes in the red and oil prices pass $US101 a barrel. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Adelaide Miller

item.title: Australia politics live: Malinauskas warns Albanese not to follow One Nation down rabbit hole of migration cuts
item.description: Follow the day’s news live Labor introducing new laws to crack down on illegal tobacco Labor will introduce new laws to make it easier to prosecute criminals involved in the illicit tobacco trade, as the government fights an uphill battle against the exploding black market. The new laws think about it as a list of observable indicators, very simple, fact-based things like: is the tobacco appropriately packaged? Is it a menthol cigarette even hiding in plain packaging? Is it being concealed? Does it have paperwork at the border? Or my personal favourite: is the retail price of this packet of… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Krishani Dhanji

item.title: Push to save teacher-librarians as student reading levels decline
item.description: A children's author launches a petition to mandate a role for teacher-librarians in Australian schools as educators phase them out despite ongoing declines in the country's student reading performance. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Malcolm Sutton

item.title: Women's tennis has a new world number one as US Open showdown looms
item.description: Elena Rybakina becomes world number one for the first time by reaching the US Open semifinals, despite defending champion and current top-ranked player Aryna Sabalenka still being alive in the tournament. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Dockers goalsneak Dudley reflects on improbable AFL rise
item.description: Plucked from state footy three years after being passed over by all 18 AFL clubs at the national draft, the shortest player in the league has become a big part of the Fremantle Dockers as they look to bounce back in the finals. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Blake Kagi and Sophie Holder

item.title: Sick of the city, Queenslanders head west and boost property prices
item.description: They lived in some of the Queensland's most sought-after areas, so what was the appeal of heading west for a country town? Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Owen Jacques

item.title: Breaking: Opals survive in last second after surrendering 20-point lead at World Cup
item.description: A short-handed Australian team is still alive and into the quarterfinals at the FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup despite surrendering a 20-point three-quarter-time lead against Italy. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Live: Expert doubts constitutionality of Commonwealth grant scheme
item.description: Jacqui Lambie launches a passionate defence of Andrew Hastie following Pauline Hanson's refusal to remove a cartoon video targeting the Liberal MP. Follow live. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Joshua Boscaini

item.title: Dog survives crocodile attack at Darwin beach
item.description: Top End residents are urged to stay vigilant near waterways after a three-year-old Cavalier King Charles Spaniel is attacked in shallow water at a Darwin beach. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Felicity James

item.title: Man charged over court data breach asked AI for legal advice, court hears
item.description: A Sydney man charged over a massive data breach involving a NSW courts website allegedly used generative AI to create "scraper" computer code for bulk downloading before asking ChatGPT for legal advice, a court hears. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jamie McKinnell

item.title: Anger as lead found at 10 Broken Hill childcare centres
item.description: The NSW Environment Protection Agency faces criticism after finding high lead contamination at 10 of Broken Hill's 13 childcare facilities. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Em Jensen and Bill Ormonde

item.title: Greyhound trainer handed lifetime ban for 'egregious' actions
item.description: SA greyhound trainer Jack Clayton Trengove has been found "entirely unfit" to participate in the industry, with the state's governing body issuing him with a lifetime disqualification and a $5,000 fine. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Evelyn Leckie and George Yankovich

item.title: Victoria’s koalas in chronically poor health and population is half what was previously estimated
item.description: Exclusive: State government delayed releasing major report into the health of the koala population for more than 12 months Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The Victorian government sat on a report for more than 12 months that found the state’s koala population was in chronically poor health. The review of the state’s koala populations, led by state science agency the Arthur Rylah Institute in conjunction with scientists from major universities, was completed for the Victorian government in June 2025. item.dc:creator: Lisa Cox Environment and climate correspondent

item.title: Three people arrested over fatal Thomastown shooting
item.description: Police investigating the fatal shooting of 22-year-old plumber Daniel Hussein in Melbourne's north have arrested three people, including two teenagers. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Watchdog's floodplain admission sparks call for immediate embargo
item.description: Calls to halt floodplain harvesting are mounting after NSW's chief water regulator revealed uncertainty around enforcing the state's water laws. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Michael Condon and Cara Jeffery

item.title: Why 42 Victorian councils are refusing to adopt purple-lid bins
item.description: Councils call on the Victorian government to reconsider a mandate requiring purple-lid glass-recycling bins to be rolled out to all homes by July 2027. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Ethan White

item.title: Australia's love for coastal living faces $850b reckoning
item.description: Australian researchers find more than 267,000 coastal properties and 2 million hectares of land across the country will face flood damage by 2100. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Company behind pulled sunscreens sued for 'misleading' conduct
item.description: The manufacturer of the base formula used by 20 sunscreens pulled from sale for failing to meet their SPF claims is being sued for misleading and deceptive conduct. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Carbonell, Pat McGrath, and Ninah Kopel

item.title: You may be waiting until at least February for that Tassie caravan holiday
item.description: Travellers hoping to jump on the new Spirit of Tasmania ferries with their cars and caravans in the coming months may have to wait, with bookings still limited to the capacity of the current ships. But TT-Line says that's not forever. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Mackenzie Heard

item.title: Patient told of year-long wait for colonoscopy after positive bowel cancer screen
item.description: Tony returned a positive result from a bowel cancer screening kit in June. Almost three months later, he is still waiting for an endoscopy to find out if he has cancer. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Clancy Balen

item.title: Winners and losers of Labor's $560m community grants
item.description: Some seats were offered tens of millions of dollars in funding for sports clubs, parks and more, while 45 seats were given nothing out of an "invite-only" grant program now under scrutiny over pork barrelling claims. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jake Evans

item.title: New tobacco laws target criminals from importers to shopfronts
item.description: Suspiciously cheap cigarettes and non-compliant packaging could help prosecutors establish whether tobacco was illicit under a crackdown targeting organised crime and retailers. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
